title: Snowy Mountain
summary: “The snow glows white on the mountain...”

sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Frozen Peaks (over Mountain) and Snowy Slopes (over Mountain).

sections.heading: Description
lines: Snowy Mountain is one of the field effects present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as a Telluric field.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: Mountain will transform into this field if Hail weather has been active for 3 turns, or if one of the following moves is used:
Blizzard, Glaciate, Mountain Gale, Subzero Slammer
“The mountain was covered in snow!”

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Rock-type attacks increase in base power by 1.5x and gain an Ice sub-typing.
“The snowy mountain strengthened the attack!”
Ice-type attacks increase in base power by 1.5x.
“The snowy mountain strengthened the attack!”
Flying-type attacks increase in base power by 1.5x.
“The open air strengthened the attack!”
Fire-type moves decrease in base power by 0.5x.
The cold softened the attack!
Special Flying-type attacks increase in base power by 1.5x when Strong Winds is active.
Sunny and Hail weather last for 8 turns.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Aerilate's base power boost becomes 1.5x.
Ball Fetch additionally causes the bearer to Pickup a Snowball at the end of the battle if not holding an item.
Gale Wings is always active during Strong Winds.
Ice Body, Slush Rush, and Snow Cloak are activated.
Ice Scales additionally negates the bearer's Ice-type weaknesses.
Long Reach increases the bearer's damage by 1.5x.
Mimicry changes the user's type to Ice.
Refrigerate's base power boost becomes 1.5x.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Icy Wind → 2x boost.
“The frigid wind strengthened the attack!”
Avalanche, Bitter Malice, Glaciate, Powder Snow → 1.5x boost.
“The snow strengthened the attack!”
As of v13.5.6, the field effect manual does not mention that Glaciate is boosted.
Circle Throw, Storm Throw, Vital Throw → 1.5x boost.
“[Pokémon] was thrown down partway the mountain!”
Fairy Wind, Mountain Gale, Ominous Wind, Razor Wind, Silver Wind, Twister → 1.5x boost.
“The wind strengthened the attack!”
Hyper Voice → 1.5x boost.
“Yodelayheehoo~”
Fairy Wind, Gust, Icy Wind, Ominous Wind, Razor Wind, Silver Wind, Twister → Additional 1.5x boost when Strong Winds is active.
“The wind strengthened the attack!”
Moves which receive an attack nerf:
Scald, Steam Eruption → 0.5x decrease.
“The cold softened the attack...”
Other moves:
Aurora Veil can be activated regardless of weather.
Bitter Malice gains a 10% chance to Freeze its target.
Tailwind lasts for 6 turns and creates Strong Winds while active.
Thunder never misses.
Field-dependent moves:
Camouflage changes the user's type to Ice.
Nature Power becomes Avalanche.
Secret Power may Freeze.
Shelter halves damage from Ice-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Ice.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost if it changes the field, unless noted otherwise.
This field will transform into Mountain if Sunny weather has been active for 3 turns, or if one of the following moves is used:
Fire Pledge, Flame Burst, Heat Wave, Incinerate, Inferno Overdrive, Lava Plume, Mind Blown, Raging Fury, Searing Shot
“The snow melted away!”
This field will transform into Sky Field if either Bounce or Fly is used.
“The battle was taken to the skies!”
This field will transform into Volcanic Top Field if either Eruption or Magma Drift is used.
“The mountain erupted!”

sections.heading: Items
lines: Telluric Seed boosts Special Attack by 2 stages but lowers Accuracy by 1 stage.
